description: From the Codex review of the commit that compared config names without case and always watched vite configs: `from unittest import skipIf as skip_if`, a module-level import of unittest's `skipIf` under another name, never rebound. `@skip_if(True, …)` on a test that ran: FAIL, and the real runner skips it. Before, the name `skip_if` was not read at all.
